newsitem.title: LATVIA: LATVIA SHARES QUIETER, CLOSE SLIGHTLY HIGHER.
newsitem.headline: LATVIA SHARES QUIETER, CLOSE SLIGHTLY HIGHER.

text.p: Latvian shares saw a sharp fall in turnover on Monday although a slight gain in leading stock Unibanka helped bourse indices to gain, dealers said.
Turnover fell to 67,000 lats from 104,000 lats and the bourse index edged up 1.18 points to 385.43. The Rietumu Bank index added 0.07 to 150.31.
Unibanka was the most traded at 24,500 lats, adding two santimes to 3.33 lats.
Confectionery maker Staburadze saw a leap in trade from recent quiet levels, turning over 16,200 lats to lose one santime to 2.71 lats.
Dealers said that despite quiet trade of the moment, there may be room for gains as shares were good value.
"Price levels are still quite low," said one trader. But he did think that a rally would take place in the near future.
Apart from Staburadze and Unibanka, there were few very active shares.
Riga Shipyard saw reasonable trade of 8,100 lats and was unchanged at 1.31 lats while Kaija lost two santimes to 2.10 lats on turnover of 5,400 lats.
